I want to set air pressure using a proportional regulator (4-20mA) connected to an analog output module. My goal is to adjust the pressure by entering a value into the HMI. Could you advise on how to properly connect and address communication between the HMI and [product_name]? Also, any guidance on programming [product_name] for this setup would be appreciated.
Hello, I'm sharing a link to an example that might be useful: [url]. Hope this helps. Thank you.
There's an easier approach — you only need to configure the connection in the HMI. No additional setup is needed in [product_name] for establishing the connection.

What is the pressure range you plan to use, such as 0-10 bar or another value? If you specify which [product_name] and [product_name] software version you have, as well as the HMI and its software, I can provide a tailored example if you wish.
